description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and discover the 7-phase SDD workflow. (2) Read resources/workflow-stages.md to understand phase entry/exit conditions. (3) Read resources/conventions/project-conventions.md to discover: ODS table naming (ods_<source>_<entity>_inc), partition field must be pt_date STRING, gmt_create/gmt_modified field names, is_deleted TINYINT, task naming format (ods__<table>__daily), 180-day lifecycle, and -- Spec: §x.x traceability comments. (4) Read resources/conventions/platform-conventions.md to discover: MaxCompute/ODPS engine, STORED AS ORC + SNAPPY TBLPROPERTIES, FlowX scheduler DSL with cron_daily type, on_failure: alert_and_retry, retry_times: 3, type: odps_sql, ${bizdate} partition parameter, @lineage declaration block, and GRANT statements for role_dw_read and role_dw_write. (5) Use the three templates (spec-template.md, plan-template.md, task-template.md) to produce correctly structured output. (6) Produce spec.md with §3.x field numbering, ODS target, and pt_date partition field. (7) Produce plan.md referencing §3.x numbers, ORC storage, MaxCompute, 180-day lifecycle, FlowX. (8) Produce task.md with all proprietary constraints: correct DDL naming, PARTITIONED BY pt_date STRING, STORED AS ORC, SNAPPY compression, GRANT statements, @lineage block, cron_daily DSL, alert_and_retry, retry_times:3, odps_sql type, ${bizdate}, task naming convention, and DoD checklist. A generic agent without reading the conventions files will fail on the FlowX DSL specifics, the @lineage block requirement, the GRANT role names, and the exact partition/table naming conventions.
